## ✅ Install-smoke proof — the last unrecorded acceptance item

Acceptance criterion: _"both bundles install and their skills load in a fresh Claude Code session (observed, not asserted); one-skill install proven for at least one skill."_ Recording it here against the shipped **0020 lineup** (#134 superseded 0007's two-bundle target with the 10-plugin desk-set).

**Method — observed, not asserted.** Each plugin was loaded from its generated on-disk artifact (`plugins/<name>/`) into a **fresh** headless session (`claude --print --output-format stream-json`). The harness's own `init` event enumerates the session's loaded `skills`/`agents` — a deterministic, non-model manifest of what actually loaded. Each session also completed a real turn (result `success`, output `OK`), so this is load **and** function, not just registration.

### Fresh-session observations

**Session A** — `cwd = repo`, the four config-inactive plugins loaded purely via `--plugin-dir`. `init` reported **9/10** loaded (all skills namespaced by plugin):

| Plugin | Kind | Skills loaded | Agents |
|---|---|---|---|
| diagrams | standalone | diagrams, drawio, excalidraw, mermaid (4) | — |
| exec-desk | desk bundle | board-triage, comms, planning-desk, pptx-themes (4) | — |
| foreman-kit | desk bundle | foreman, handoff (2) | builder, lead, reviewer, scout (4) |
| github-project-board | standalone | github-project-board (1) | — |
| obsidian-toolkit | standalone | obsidian-api-basics, obsidian-chat-ui, obsidian-cli, obsidian-mcp-server (4) | — |
| opencode-expertise | standalone | opencode-expertise (1) | — |
| owner-signoff | standalone | owner-signoff (1) | — |
| pptx-themes | standalone | pptx-themes (1) | — |
| private-fork | standalone | private-fork (1) | — |

> Note: `diagrams` + `private-fork` were `disabled` and `pptx-themes` + `obsidian-toolkit` were `not-installed` in this machine's config — they loaded **from the tracked artifact** via `--plugin-dir`, which is exactly the "install into a fresh session and watch it load" proof.

**Session B** — `cwd = neutral` (no project scope), `--plugin-dir plugins/code-desk`. `init` reported **code-desk** loading all 7 skills: memory-taxonomy, mise-en-place-scaffold, opencode-expertise, private-fork, readme-value-and-proof, repo-compliance-audit, repo-meta-structure.

**Union = 10/10 lineup plugins observed loading from their generated artifacts.**

### Cross-checks

- **Live interactive session:** this session (running against `dotfiles-agents@main`) has code-desk, exec-desk, foreman-kit, github-project-board, opencode-expertise, owner-signoff loaded and usable; foreman-kit's four agent types are dispatchable.
- **One-skill install (criterion, explicit):** the 5 one-skill standalone plugins — github-project-board, opencode-expertise, owner-signoff, pptx-themes, private-fork — each loaded their single skill. Comfortably exceeds "at least one." `make catalog` confirms all 5 wrappers byte-identical to source.
- **Gate run locally (not asserted):** `make ci` **green** — 120 tests; roster↔disk clean (31 primitives), identity-neutral, provenance clean, hook-layout clean, skill-catalog + standalone-wrapper invariants OK, marketplace artifacts match source (no drift).
- **State:** `dev` and `main` level at `a6c77e4`; marketplace resolves by name (`code-desk@dotfiles-agents` et al. install and enable).

All acceptance criteria for this epic are now met. Closing.
